Type an app name in braille

Type an app name in braille. Swipe up or down with one finger to choose a result. One finger left deletes, one finger right adds a space. Two fingers right opens the selected app. Two fingers left or down closes search.
Unlock the phone to search for apps in braille. This interface requires Android 11 or later.
